findings.evidenceJa: 五メートルの高さから
findings.governingReading: from a height of five meters
findings.explanation: The exact danger and geometry of Shirou’s leap disappear.

findings.highlight: He has no emotion for the one who appeared
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎に抱く感慨などない
findings.governingReading: he feels nothing in particular about Emiya Shirou
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s specific absence of feeling toward Shirou becomes an awkward generic referent.

findings.evidenceJa: 死神の釘
findings.governingReading: the death god’s nail
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s fist image changes weapons from a driven nail to a scythe.

findings.highlight: have my neck snapped like a flower
findings.evidenceJa: 茎のように首を折られる
findings.governingReading: have my neck snapped like a stem
findings.explanation: The simile’s fragile structural element becomes the entire flower.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=トレース char=2]投影、[ruby text=オン o2o=1]開始
findings.governingReading: Projection—start
findings.explanation: The displayed projection/start relation is compressed into a different English incantation.

findings.evidenceJa: いかなる領域の業
findings.governingReading: whatever domain the craft belongs to
findings.explanation: Category or domain becomes magnitude.

findings.evidenceJa: （暴走）
findings.governingReading: (Runaway)
findings.explanation: A runaway or loss-of-control warning is relabeled as excessive load.

findings.evidenceJa: 憑依された経験
findings.governingReading: the experience inhabiting it
findings.explanation: The weapon’s inherited or possessed experience becomes biological growth.

findings.highlight: I will die if I reproduce swords?
findings.evidenceJa: 剣製を行えば死ぬ？
findings.governingReading: Will creating swords kill me?
findings.explanation: The English word order reads as assertion plus question mark and replaces sword creation with reproduction.

findings.evidenceJa: 剣と[ruby text=とも o2o=1]融合に生きてきた
findings.governingReading: I have lived fused together with swords
findings.explanation: Shirou’s bodily fusion with swords is reduced to companionship.

findings.evidenceJa: 左腕は潰された
findings.governingReading: my left arm was crushed
findings.explanation: The damaged body part changes from the full left arm to the shoulder.

findings.evidenceJa: 憎まれ口を、たたいていた
findings.governingReading: is flinging an abusive remark at me
findings.explanation: Rin’s hostile cover for relief is flattened into complaint.

findings.evidenceJa: この判りづらい人の良さ
findings.governingReading: this hard-to-read goodness of hers
findings.explanation: The defining difficulty of perceiving Rin’s kindness disappears.

findings.highlight: We have to get out of here alive
findings.evidenceJa: 無傷でここから外に出なくちゃいけない
findings.governingReading: we have to get out of here without a scratch
findings.explanation: The goal of escaping uninjured is weakened to mere survival.

findings.highlight: I’ll listen once we get out of here
findings.evidenceJa: 一息つけたらちゃんと聞く
findings.governingReading: I will hear you out properly once we can catch our breath
findings.explanation: A short tactical pause becomes completion of the whole escape.

findings.highlight: The knight in red stops the attack
findings.evidenceJa: 赤い騎士が場を制した
findings.governingReading: the red knight takes control of the scene
findings.explanation: Archer’s intervention governs the whole confrontation, not only an attack.

findings.evidenceJa: 他人事のような提案
findings.governingReading: a proposal made as though it concerned someone else
findings.explanation: Archer’s feigned personal detachment is mistaken for impartial objectivity.

findings.evidenceJa: 人並みのコトを言えたものね
findings.governingReading: how impressive that you can say something ordinarily human
findings.explanation: Caster’s insult about Archer displaying normal human decency disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 手早く死んだ方がいい
findings.governingReading: they would be better off dying quickly
findings.explanation: Archer’s cruelly pragmatic advice becomes moral condemnation.

findings.highlight: run like the dogs you are
findings.evidenceJa: 敗者は敗者らしく逃げるように立ち去りなさい
findings.governingReading: leave by fleeing, as befits losers
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents a dog insult and drops Caster’s repeated loser framing.

findings.evidenceJa: 呼吸を鎮めて
findings.governingReading: I steady my breathing
findings.explanation: A concrete bodily action becomes a general emotional state.

findings.highlight: She’s biting her lip in anger
findings.evidenceJa: 悔しげに唇を噛んでいた
findings.governingReading: she was biting her lip in frustration
findings.explanation: Rin’s frustrated regret is narrowed to anger.

findings.evidenceJa: 堂々とした足取りのまま
findings.governingReading: with the same dignified stride
findings.explanation: Rin’s controlled gait becomes vague, unnatural praise.

findings.evidenceJa: 地下聖堂からここまで、一度も言葉は交わさなかった
findings.governingReading: we exchanged no words even once from the underground sanctuary all the way here
findings.explanation: The duration and route of the silence disappear.
